officialTitle: Phase III study of afatinib or cisplatin plus pemetrexed in patients with metastatic lung adenocarcinoma with EGFR mutations

design.sampleSizeSourceQuote: A total of 1,269 patients were screened, and 345 were randomly assigned to treatment.
design.notes: 2:1 randomisation, stratified by mutation type (exon 19 deletion, L858R, other) and race.

clinicalQuestion: Does the irreversible ErbB family blocker afatinib improve PFS over cisplatin-pemetrexed in EGFR-mutant advanced lung adenocarcinoma?

pico.population: Stage IIIB/IV lung adenocarcinoma with EGFR mutations
pico.comparator: Cisplatin plus pemetrexed, up to six cycles
pico.outcomes: Primary: PFS by independent review. Secondary: response, OS, adverse events, PROs

arms.label: Afatinib
arms.doseSourceQuote: two-to-one random assignment to 40 mg afatinib per day

arms.label: Cisplatin-pemetrexed
arms.regimen: Cisplatin plus pemetrexed, up to six cycles every 21 days

publications.title: Phase III study of afatinib or cisplatin plus pemetrexed in patients with metastatic lung adenocarcinoma with EGFR mutations.
publications.label: Primary analysis

outcomes.sourceQuote: Median PFS was 11.1 months for afatinib and 6.9 months for chemotherapy (hazard ratio [HR], 0.58; 95% CI, 0.43 to 0.78; P = .001).
Median PFS among those with exon 19 deletions and L858R EGFR mutations (n = 308) was 13.6 months for afatinib and 6.9 months for chemotherapy (HR, 0.47; 95% CI, 0.34 to 0.65; P = .001).

safety.sourceQuote: The most common treatment-related adverse events were diarrhea, rash/acne, and stomatitis for afatinib and nausea, fatigue, and decreased appetite for chemotherapy.

strengths: Stratified by mutation type, enabling common-mutation analysis
limitations: Comparator was chemotherapy rather than a first-generation EGFR TKI

clinicalImplications.text: Supported afatinib as a first-line option for EGFR-mutant advanced adenocarcinoma, with the greatest PFS benefit in common (exon 19 deletion/L858R) mutations.

tumourBoardPearl.text: Second-generation irreversible ErbB blockade buys PFS at the cost of more diarrhoea, rash and stomatitis — dose management matters.

curation.notes: All numbers transcribed from the PubMed abstract of PMID 23816960. Pooled LUX-Lung 3/6 OS analyses not ingested.
